name: Layer stack collapse
looks: A deck of flat, translucent shapes sits stacked with a slight 3D offset, each named by a small label on a leader line. The whole stack compresses straight down into a single solid, opaque shape of the same silhouette: many rules read as one simple result.
build: Each layer is a shape offset by translateY/translateZ under a shared perspective, opacity decreasing toward the back; labels fade in on leader lines, staggered on the beat. The collapse tweens every layer's y/z to 0 and opacity to 1 on power3.in, finishing as one flat shape; labels fade out just before impact.
sound: A soft layered hum while the stack is held, and a single solid thump on the collapse.
prompt: Show a stack of ordered rules or steps as translucent layered shapes, each named on a leader line, then collapse the whole stack into a single solid shape to say the complexity resolves to one simple result.
source: a Lism CSS release video in prompt-motion.com's gallery (prompt-motion.com/ddryo-loos-300829), studied 2026-10-09
